observations: Follow-up filed: LEGION-142 (Dispatch browser tests write screenshots to fixed /tmp paths and fail on a shared box).

Acceptance 1 height: the 'about 140px' budget holds only for a one-line title with no external link (134px). A two-line title (38 characters in the ~530px main column at 1280 with the sidebar and margin open) gives 160px; a GitHub link gives 166px because the link takes a full row (rendered as the raw URL here since the e2e server has no GitHub App credentials; the production render is PR title + state + checks pills in an inline-flex with no truncation, so it is not narrower); link plus the approval chip and Approve / Request changes gives 206px.

Acceptance 4 at 1280: with the sidebar (320px) and the review margin open the main column is about 530px, and the Version / Name version / Copy link toolbar wraps to a right-aligned second row under the tabs (y212 vs tabs y170). They share the tab row from 1536px. The Name version button's visible text is 'Name'; its accessible name is 'Name version'.
The whose-turn pill is display:none between 1280 and 1535px (IssueHeader.tsx 'xl:hidden 2xl:inline-flex'); at the acceptance-1 width a human sees the count only in the sidebar's Needs you badge.

Devbox: http://sami-agents:8766 resolves to this host; envoy-dispatch-dispatch-1 exited 3 hours before this run and no later container was created after #1073-#1078 merged, so its autodeploy appears stopped in favour of the ECS instance. Read-only confirmation of #1051 on the deployed build was done by fetching the ECS SPA's IssuePage chunk unauthenticated and grepping the #1051 markers.

Test-suite fragility (follow-up, not a LEGION-62 defect): agents, ask-blocks, inbox and polish e2e specs write screenshots to hardcoded /tmp/<name>.png paths; on a shared box a file left by another user makes those tests fail with EACCES before their final assertions. Filed as a LEGION issue.

Workspace note: the daemon's working copy was on a197cdc0 (before #1051); the working-copy commit holding only .omp/config.yml was moved onto main@origin 7a178581 with jj rebase -r @ -d main@origin (no PR branch, no CI). All throwaway spec files (e2e/legion62-verify.e2e.ts, e2e/legion62-tmpfix-*.e2e.ts) and e2e/test-results were removed; the Postgres container, servers and web/dist E2E build are torn down / left untracked.

proof.criterion: 1. At 1280px the header shows key and title first; status and priority pills, approval chip only after a request (no Draft), Close / Pin / Approve / Request changes as quiet actions; details on the state row or one line beneath; header about 140px.
proof.surface: Local build of main in Chromium 1280x900 and 1280x800 through the packages/dispatch e2e harness (real Go server, Postgres, header identity alice).
proof.command: cd packages/dispatch && VITE_DISPATCH_E2E=1 bun run build:web && bash e2e/run-server.sh (DISPATCH_E2E_PORT=8762) && env -u CI bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium legion62-verify (throwaway spec e2e/legion62-verify.e2e.ts, removed after the run)
proof.observed: Row tops: key+title+pin 37; Status/Priority/Close 77-83 and Subscribers 79 on the state row; Labels+Route 149 on one line beneath (GitHub link 121 on its own line when present). Before an approval request: no Draft, no chip, no Approve; after requestApproval: 'Awaiting approval' chip plus Approve and Request changes. Height 134px (one-line title, no link), 160px (two-line title), 166px (GitHub link), 206px (link + chip + actions). Screenshots verified-header-1280, verified-header-oneline-title-1280, verified-header-approval-1280.
proof.negativeControl: Before any approval request the header renders no approval chip and no Draft text (getByText(/Draft|Awaiting approval|Approved|Changes requested/) count 0, Approve button count 0).

proof.criterion: 4. Version and Name version sit at the right end of the tab row only while the Spec tab is active, and never in the header.
proof.surface: Local build of main in Chromium at 1280x900, 1536x900 and 390x844.
proof.command: same throwaway spec, test 'acceptance 4': open /issues/CORE-1, click Conversation, Children, Artifacts, Spec at each width
proof.observed: Spec tab: Version select and Name version button inside data-testid=issue-tabs, none inside issue-header. 1536: Version at y133 on the tab row (tabs y130), right of the Artifacts tab (x837 > 667). 1280 with sidebar and margin open: they wrap to a right-aligned second row (y212 under tabs at y170). 390: Version + Name on one row under the tabs, Copy link on the next, all within 390px. Conversation, Children, Artifacts: zero Version / Name version controls anywhere on the page at all three widths. Screenshots verified-tabs-spec-1280, verified-tabs-spec-1536, verified-tabs-spec-390, verified-tabs-conversation-1280.
proof.negativeControl: On the Conversation tab getByRole('combobox',{name:'Version'}) and getByRole('button',{name:'Name version'}) both have count 0 (the controls are absent, not merely hidden).

proof.criterion: 5. Adding a label opens a compact popover with a search box and a check list; typing filters; Enter creates; labels save once when the popover closes.
proof.surface: Local build of main in Chromium at 1280x900 and 390x844, PATCH requests counted through page.on('request').
proof.observed: Edit labels opens a 256x239 popover: focused combobox 'Search or create label' and listbox 'Label options' with api, Frontend checked and backend, docs unchecked. Typing 'doc' leaves only docs plus Create "doc"; typing 'urgent' then Enter checks urgent. Zero PATCHes while open; closing sends exactly one PATCH {labels:[Frontend,api,urgent]} and GET /issues/CORE-1 returns those labels. At 390 the popover spans x118-374, inside the viewport. Screenshots verified-label-popover-1280, verified-label-popover-41-refused-1280, verified-label-popover-390.
proof.negativeControl: A 41-character label typed then Enter: the picker shows 'Labels must be 1–40 characters.', adds no option, and closing sends no PATCH (count stays 1; labels unchanged). PATCH /api/v1/issues/CORE-1 {labels:[Frontend, <41 x>]} from the API answers 400 {code:LABELS_INPUT, error:'each label must be 1 to 40 characters'} and the labels stay [Frontend, api, urgent].

proof.criterion: 7. A human can move the issue into any lifecycle status from the header's status select, including In progress, Testing, Needs review and Retro; confirmed on the board.
proof.surface: Local build of main in Chromium at 1280x900 as alice; API read back with GET /api/v1/issues/CORE-1; board at /projects/CORE (Board view).
proof.observed: Header Status select offers Triage, Icebox, Backlog, Todo, In progress, Testing, Needs review, Retro. Selecting each of In progress, Testing, Needs review, Retro: API status becomes in_progress, testing, needs_review, retro and the board region with that name holds the CORE-1 card. Screenshot verified-status-board-retro-1280.
proof.negativeControl: PATCH /api/v1/issues/CORE-1 {status:'shipped'} answers 400 {code:INVALID_STATUS, error:'status is not in the Legion lifecycle'} and the status stays retro.

proof.criterion: 8. The header's existing behaviours still work: the Dispatch web app's browser test suite passes on current main.
proof.surface: packages/dispatch Playwright suite against the real Go server and Postgres (e2e/run-server.sh), chromium and iphone projects.
proof.command: env -u CI bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --grep-invert legion62-verify (log /tmp/legion62-e2e-chromium.log); then --project=iphone; reruns: --project=chromium legion62-tmpfix doc.e2e.ts
proof.observed: chromium: 110 tests, 98 passed, 6 skipped, 6 failed; every failure passes on rerun: agents.e2e.ts:35, ask-blocks.e2e.ts:20 and :187, inbox.e2e.ts:34, polish.e2e.ts:14 failed only with EACCES writing hardcoded /tmp/<name>.png screenshot files owned by user ubuntu on this shared box (copies of those four specs with the path changed to a writable directory pass 12/12 on chromium and 12/12 on iphone); doc.e2e.ts:105 ('two users edit the same spec...') is the named two-user timing flake and passed in isolation. iphone: 122 tests, 113 passed, 4 skipped, 5 failed, all five the same EACCES. issue, labels, layout, board, inbox, approval, threads and ask-blocks are green on both projects.
proof.negativeControl: The suite is not vacuous: run under the pane's inherited CI=true it refused to start with 'http://localhost:9062 is already used' (reuseExistingServer is !CI), and the same six specs fail deterministically when their screenshot path is not writable.

implementerProof.how: No .legion/implement.json exists for this integration check; the predecessor proofs are the five merged PR bodies. Re-ran the measurable claims on main 7a178581: #1051's 'header card 134px at 1280x800' reproduces exactly (134.0px with a one-line title, two labels, no external link, margin open); #1040's labels picker and #1041's eight-status header select and board move reproduce through the browser; the labels, board, approval and ask-blocks specs those PRs cite are green. #1012's '390 phone stack cleanly with no orphaned controls' does not hold on current main (Close, Subscribers and the GitHub link each sit alone on a row); that is recorded as the acceptance-2 failure rather than a rejection of the proof, since #1012's claim predates #1051's header changes.

acceptance.note: Layout order holds at 1280; height is 134px with a one-line title and no external link, 160px when the title wraps to two lines, 166px with a GitHub link, 206px with a GitHub link plus the approval chip and actions.
Order holds and nothing is cut off, but Close, Subscribers and the GitHub link each sit alone on their own row; the header is 480px tall at 390x844.
Title line does not move and chips do not wrap, but the metadata line does not scroll sideways: chips run past the header card and the whole page becomes horizontally scrollable.

Version / Name version appear only with the Spec tab and never in the header, at 1280, 1536 and 390. At 1536 they share the tab row at its right end; at 1280 with the sidebar and margin open (main column ~530px) they wrap to a right-aligned second row under the tabs.

Compact popover (256x239) with search box and check list; typing filters; Enter creates; exactly one PATCH on close; a 41-character label is refused in the picker and by the server (400 LABELS_INPUT) and nothing is saved.

The header never flips to Waiting on agents after a human reply (1536 and 390, live and after reload); the Inbox flips for the same ask. Cause: GET /api/v1/issues/{key} open_asks rows carry no last_reply, and waitingOnYou reads last_reply.author.kind. Also hidden entirely at 1280-1535px (xl:hidden).
In progress, Testing, Needs review and Retro each selectable from the header; API and board column agree; an unknown status is refused 400 INVALID_STATUS.

chromium: 98 passed, 6 skipped, 6 failed of which all 6 pass on rerun (5 were EACCES on /tmp/*.png screenshot files owned by another user of this shared box; 1 was the named doc.e2e.ts:135 two-user timing flake, green in isolation). iphone: 113 passed, 4 skipped, 5 failed, all five the same EACCES; the same specs with a writable screenshot path pass 12/12. issue, labels, layout, board, inbox, approval, threads and ask-blocks are green on both projects.

failures.criterion: 3. With eight labels of thirty characters each, the title line does not move and the metadata line scrolls sideways instead of wrapping, at both widths.
failures.evidence: Local build of main 7a178581. Labels patched through PATCH /api/v1/issues/CORE-1 (eight 30-character labels), reload. 1280x900: title box identical before/after (x435.4 y37 h58); chips stay on one row (flex-nowrap) but the labels container is 1714px wide with overflow-x visible and no scroll container, so the chips run past the header card's right edge under the margin column and document.documentElement.scrollWidth becomes 2129 (viewport 1280): the page pans, the line does not scroll. 390x844: title identical (x37 y122 h66); labels container 1794px, metadata rail clientWidth 316 / scrollWidth 1852, document scrollWidth 1889 (viewport 390). Screenshots dispatch://LEGION-62/artifact/verified-labels-wrap-1280-png and dispatch://LEGION-62/artifact/verified-labels-wrap-390-png. failures.criterion: 6. The header shows Waiting on you (N) while an open ask has an agent's reply as its newest, and Waiting on agents (N) after a human replies.
failures.evidence: Local build of main 7a178581. Ask created by session e2e-session on CORE-1; header at 1536x900 shows 'Waiting on you (1)'. alice posts a clarification (POST /api/v1/issues/CORE-1/comments {ask_id, body}) as a human: the header still shows 'Waiting on you (1)' after 10s live and after a reload; same at 390. The Inbox for the same ask shows the 'Waiting on agents' section, so the predicate is right and the header's input is wrong: GET /api/v1/issues/CORE-1 returns open_asks rows with keys id, issue_key, artifact_id, block_id, author, kind, question, options, multiple, urgency, anchor, state, answer, opened_event_id, created_at, edited_at and no last_reply (issue_queries.go loadOpenAsks -> []model.Ask), while GET /api/v1/inbox rows carry last_reply {author:{kind:user,id:alice}}. IssueHeader.tsx computes waitingOnYou(issue.open_asks), and BlockedOnYou.tsx filters on ask.last_reply?.author.kind !== 'user', which is always true without the field. IssuePage.test.tsx:1154 passes only because it stubs open_asks[].last_reply, a field the server never sends. Screenshots dispatch://LEGION-62/artifact/verified-whose-turn-after-human-reply-1536-png and dispatch://LEGION-62/artifact/verified-whose-turn-after-human-reply-390-png. Separately, the pill is display:none at 1280-1535px (IssueHeader.tsx: 'xl:hidden 2xl:inline-flex'), so at the acceptance-1 width the header shows no whose-turn indicator at all (measured: hidden at 1280, visible at 1536 and 390).
